the Elk-1 transcription factor is a novel target of SUMOylation.

SUMOylation of Elk-1 regulates nuclear retention and that this regulation affects Elk-1 function.

the role of the ubiquitin-like protein SUMO (Small Ubiquitin-like MOdifier) in transcriptional regulation.
the identification of novel regulatory mechanisms for the transcriptional regulator Elk-1.
the role of posttranslational modification in the regulation of transcription factor function.
